(a)5 - 1:
	5 -> 00101
	(-1) -> 11111
	00101 + 11111 = 00100
	00100 -> 4
(b)12 - 5:
	12 -> 01100
	(-5) -> 11011
	01100 + 11011 = 00111
	00111 -> 7
(c)8 - 7:
	8 -> 01000
	(-7) -> 11001
	01000 + 11001 = 00001
	00001 -> 1
(d)12 + 5:
	12 -> 01100
	5 -> 00101
	01100 + 00101 = 10001
	10001 -> -16 (overflow occured and 010001 = 17 turned into -15)
(e)5-11:
	5 -> 00101
	(-11) -> 10101
	00101 + 10101 = 11010
	11010 -> -6
